findings.summary: An inconclusive inline read-back after a takeover claim lets startup recovery queue a second resume, against the accepted 'at most once'; safe (read only, every guard re-applies); the owner ruled 2026-10-18 to keep the re-drive and amend the ADR
reconcile -> _apply_receipt -> _set_run_state(VERIFYING) attaches the continuation (snapshot=True) before queueing a resume, against the ADR text
Dropping the STOP branch in _after_step_verified (falls through to START, a write) is killed only by server tests; a kernel test is owed and non-START should be rejected explicitly
The VERIFYING + COMMITTED + no-pending-work window lasts until the next startup recovery; say so in the ADR and the handoff
C2-1, C2-2 and C-1..C-3 verified clean by mutation
